items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 13 May 2026 at 11:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

High pressure in the mid-Atlantic, and low pressure to the west of Norway, with various troughs affecting the British Isles.


##Wind##

Northwest 5 or 6, occasionally 7 in the southwest at first, gradually decreasing north or northwest 4 or 5 overnight, occasionally 6 in places.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, falling slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, with isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or possibly poor in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

North or Northwest 4 to 6.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, with occasional rain or showers, becoming fair overnight into Friday.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain or showers.
